bullets.text: Built and maintained a modular Python pipeline on Linux – data loaders, model architecture, training scripts, SLURM job configs – processing 35,704 simulation frames on UF’s HiPerGator HPC cluster with NVIDIA L4/T4 GPUs, collaborating with researchers and faculty in weekly technical meetings.
Engineered and evaluated 3 conditional diffusion model architectures in PyTorch, debugging a 5× encoding-decoding performance gap and integrating the optimal architecture to improve system accuracy.

Replaced ground truth guidance with a physics-based dynamics model trained on 30,000 self-collected trajectories, achieving within 5.4% of ground-truth-guided performance across 6,318 test frames without simulator state access.

Scaled RESTful microservices for a Django-based SaaS platform serving 5,000+ daily users, improving performance by 25% through query optimization, indexing, and caching – ensuring high reliability and low-latency response times.
Designed optimized PostgreSQL schemas and integrated Celery for asynchronous tasks, collaborating with senior engineers to ensure high responsiveness and zero downtime during migrations.
Containerized backend services with Docker, automated CI/CD pipelines in Jenkins, and wrote unit and integration tests for API endpoints – ensuring deployment reliability and maintainability.

Engineered a scalable commerce platform with Spring Boot, React and MySQL – implementing Stripe payment processing, JWT authentication, role-based authorization, shopping cart, checkout, and product catalog supporting 10K+ products.
Containerized services with Docker and deployed to a Kubernetes cluster for multi-service orchestration.
Provisioned AWS infrastructure (EC2, RDS) using Terraform, implemented CI/CD pipelines for automated deployments and wrote unit and integration tests for API endpoints and authentication flows.

Built an agentic SRE system using LangGraph that detects anomalies, reasons over live telemetry, and remediates failures across an 11-service Kubernetes environment – achieving 85% success rate and 4.3-min MTTR across 20 chaos scenarios.
Implemented a RAG pipeline using ChromaDB to retrieve operational context from historical incidents, grounding LLM root-cause analysis in Prometheus metrics, Loki logs, and GitHub deployment history.
Exposed Kubernetes, Prometheus, Loki, GitHub, and Slack as MCP tool servers in a 5-node remediation pipeline – with human-in-the-loop approval for high-risk actions and PostgreSQL audit logging.

Built a four-phase NLP pipeline for paraphrase detection on 5,800+ adversarial sentence pairs, progressing from Word2Vec baselines (53%) through fine-tuned RoBERTa cross-encoder (84%) to Gemini-based LLM reasoning (91%).

Identified independent sentence encoding as the non-obvious root cause of bi-encoder failure and resolved it through cross-encoder fine-tuning, improving accuracy by 38 percentage points over baseline.
